notes: SOURCE: NeoSeal Adhesive "Price List 2025" for CoEx Can, list no. PL_012026, "Effective From 5th May 2025" (8 pages; copy supplied by the shop, Oct 2026). Every priced line on pages 3–8 is included (pages 1–2 are the cover, company profile and certificates). Terms printed in the list: Freight to pay, payment 21 days.

PRICE BASIS: the price column is headed "M.R.P. (₹) per Unit". The list does not say in words whether taxes are included; an MRP is by law the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, so listPrice = mrp = the printed MRP with listPriceIncludesTax true. The shop's buying price will be lower (NeoSeal sells to dealers at a discount on MRP); items the list marks "* Fixed Rate – No Discount" (PVC-UPVC tubes, Neo Tite 25 g and 50 g, PTFE tape 12 mm × 5 m) say so in their priceSource. marketPrice is null everywhere: no local selling prices were researched.

UNITS: one tube, can, tin, jar, cartridge, sachet or valve = pcs; tapes = roll; products the list shows in sacks (tile adhesives, block jointing mortar, Grout GP22, floor hardener) = bag. The list also gives units per case and per carton; those are trade packing quantities and are not used. No price was divided.

GAPS: PU 600 Polyurethane Adhesive 30 L has no price in the list (printed "-"); it is included with an empty price. The application-area chart on page 8 also names "567 Crack Filler Powder", which has no price row and was left out.

CATEGORIES: solvent cements, P-38 primer, PTFE tape, thread sealant, gasket shellac, rubber lubricant, epoxy putties, silicone/acrylic sealants and drain cleaner → plumbing-accessories; CPVC ball valves → cpvc-pipes-fittings; UPVC and Agri/R PVC ball valves → pvc-upvc-pipes-fittings; construction chemicals (tile adhesives and grouts, block jointing mortar, waterproofing chemicals and coatings, repair products, floor hardener), and products that are clearly not plumbing (footwear/foam synthetic-rubber and PU adhesives and their 623/624/625 primers, instant adhesives, 755 epoxy adhesive, ND-80 spray, NeoTape electrical tape) → other-building-materials. Move them if the shop prefers otherwise.

HSN / GST: 3506 for solvent cements, the P-38 solvent-cement primer (Finolex prints 35061000 for its own PVC/CPVC primer) and the adhesives (synthetic rubber, PU, cyanoacrylate, epoxy); 3919 for PTFE tape and PVC insulation tape; 8481 for ball valves. The NeoSeal list prints no HSN codes, so HSN is left empty for sealants, putties, primers for footwear, lubricants, drain cleaner, tile adhesives, grouts, mortars and waterproofing/construction chemicals – the shop's accountant should fill them in. GST is set to 18% for everything (not stated in the list).

STANDARDS as printed on the list cover: NSF applies only to NeoSeal 205, 305, 217, 314 and P-38 Primer; IS 14182 (ISI) only to the 105 and 110 solvent cements; IS 2645 to the IWP 500 and IWP 510 integral waterproofing compounds. Tile adhesive classes are as printed in the 2025 list (an older NeoSeal datasheet found by web search gives 552 Gold as C1T; the list says C2T – Type II).

WEB SOURCES: neoseal.net could not be opened from this session (DNS failure for the site), so no images could be confirmed and images are empty. The official pages added to sourceUrls (solvent cement page, P-38 primer page, SR 606 page) were confirmed to exist by web search only; every fact in this file comes from the price list itself, including text printed on the pack pictures (e.g. epoxy putty set times, 561 grout joint width, 560 BJM uses).
